' within the first ~12 tokens of a text, i.e. the newline(s) ending a short opening title or header line such as 'Carl Nielsen

' or 'package config

'. It is strongest when the newline directly follows a word rather than a period, and it falls steadily with position, so newlines after ~20 tokens of prose are weak or inactive.
